title: Allegiant Pledges $20,000 to Dolly Parton Children's Hospital in Knoxville, Tennessee
summary: Allegiant Travel Company (NASDAQ: ALGT) today pledged $20,000 to the Dolly Parton Children's Hospital in Knoxville, Tennessee. Gifted in memory of entertainer, philanthropist, and East Tennessee native Dolly Parton, the donation will support the late legend's namesake hospital located near one of the biggest crew bases in the airline's network: McGhee Tyson Airport (TYS).
